verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains only generic marketing/spec claims and community discussion about hardware issues, pricing, and power draw, but no explicit mention of Linux driver releases, Linux driver documentation, or independent Linux-specific benchmarking/testing of the RTX PRO 6000. While community posts imply GPU compute usage (e.g., tok/s benchmarks), none confirm the OS used or reference NVIDIA's Linux driver support documentation. Missing for 10: documented Linux driver release notes, first-party Linux support docs, and independent Linux-based testing/benchmarks explicitly identifying Linux as the platform.
